32b9(1): myi dmyigaso/rab 'byord brtson 'grus kyi pha rold tu phyind ba'i dngo bo nyid bsam gyis myi khyab tu myed gzhal du myed la myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/de'i pyir brtson 'grus kyi pha roladag tu phyind pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang tshad dag
